verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents first-party AI insight features that run on a user's transcribed audio: LLM-generated summaries, sentiment tracking, topic detection and auto-summarized chapters. These are returned by the product itself, not built by the user. Each feature is documented only as a one-line claim, and nothing shows actionable suggestions or how the insights surface in the web platform. Missing for 10: actionable suggestions/recommendations, evidence of insights shown inside the web platform UI, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.
